title: REPORT on the control of the financial activities of the European Investment Bank Group – annual report 2024
part_text: 7. Calls on the EIB to ensure that all its energy financing is consistent with the Paris Agreement and the EIB Climate Bank Roadmap; calls on the EIB to evaluate all low-carbon projects against objective and transparent criteria, including life-cycle carbon intensity, grid stability, cost-effectiveness and avoidance of lock-in and stranded-asset risks; notes that the EIB invested over EUR 27 billion in the energy transition and in energy security in 2024, including renewables, grids and storage; calls on the EIB to prioritise energy efficiency, demand reduction, grids, storage and renewables, while fully respecting Member States’ sovereign right to determine their energy mix;
